cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 87% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.91% · WTI +2.19% · Brent +2.45% · NatGas +2.25%. 87% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +4.55%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.55%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.53%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +14.94%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +14.94%, EOSE +11.49%, VRT +6.32%, ARRY +5.81%, FLNC +5.19%. Laggards: FSLR -1.94%, PEG -0.98%, DUK -0.73%, NEE -0.65%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
